content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

In the next 24 hours, you can deploy a fully functional digital commerce stack using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This stack will enable you to sell digital products, receive international payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, and deliver products directly to your customers. With a few simple steps and no prior technical expertise, you can set up a payment processing system that settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack that works consists of GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack is not a workaround, but rather a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives you full control over your digital commerce operations. You can deploy this stack in 48 hours with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which includes 30-day support.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Many creators spend months trying to figure out how to integrate multiple payment gateways, set up complex payment workflows, and handle product delivery. But with blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure, you can skip these steps altogether. Focus on deploying a basic stack that works, and then scale up as needed. The key is to start with a minimum viable stack and iterate from there.
You can start selling digital products and receiving international payments in under 24 hours.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on deploying the minimum viable stack that works. Start by setting up a GitHub Pages site, creating a Cloudflare Workers script, and configuring NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Then, test your setup with a small transaction and get your first payment live. Don't worry about scaling up just yet – focus on getting the basics right.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a fully functional digital commerce stack in the next 24 hours, follow these steps: Deploy a GitHub Pages site using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). Create a Cloudflare Workers script to handle backend logic. Configure NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Test your setup with a small transaction and get your first payment live. Set up a payment button using NOWPayments. Integrate the payment button with your Cloudflare Workers script. Start selling digital products and receiving international payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a NOWPayments account?

To set up a NOWPayments account, simply create an account on the NOWPayments website and follow the instructions to configure your payment settings. Once you've set up your account, you can create a payment button and integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers script.
What payment methods do you support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron. You can also use Binance P2P to buy and sell cryptocurrencies locally in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan.
How do I handle product delivery?

With Cloudflare infrastructure, you can deliver products directly to your customers without relying on a third-party platform. Simply configure your Cloudflare Workers script to handle product delivery, and you're good to go.
Can I use blockchain-based payments with other platforms?

Yes, you can use blockchain-based payments with other platforms, such as Shopify or WooCommerce. However, with Cloudflare infrastructure, you can start selling digital products and receiving international payments without depending on a single platform.
